# Wayground
> Wayground (formerly Quizizz) is an AI-powered teaching platform with standards-aligned resources, assessment tools, and classroom content generators for K–12 educators.

Wayground helps teachers and school systems create lessons, quizzes, worksheets, rubrics, and presentations, while tracking student progress and supporting differentiated instruction. The platform also includes standards-based resource discovery and a grade-banded math video library.

## Core Platform
- [Wayground Homepage](https://wayground.com): Main entry point for Wayground’s teacher AI tools, classroom resources, and instructional platform.
- [From Quizizz to Wayground](https://wayground.com/home/from-quizizz-to-wayground): Rebrand announcement explaining the transition from Quizizz to Wayground.
- [Plans](https://wayground.com/home/plans): Pricing and plan comparison for teachers, schools, and districts.
- [School & District](https://wayground.com/home/schools-and-districts): Overview of district-focused curriculum, assessment, and reporting capabilities.

## AI Generators
- [AI Presentation Maker](https://wayground.com/generators/ai-presentation-maker): Generates classroom presentations from prompts for grade-level and subject-specific instruction.
- [AI Question Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/multiple-choice-question-generator): Creates multiple-choice questions for quizzes, checks for understanding, and assessments.
- [AI Rubric Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/rubric-generator): Builds grading rubrics aligned to assignments, standards, and learning goals.
- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/lesson-plan-generator): Produces structured lesson plans tailored by subject, grade, and objective.
- [AI Math Problem Generator](http://wayground.com/generators/math-problem-generator): Generates math practice problems by topic, grade, and difficulty level.
- [Unit Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/unit-plan-generator): Creates multi-lesson unit plans organized around standards and outcomes.
- [Weekly Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/weekly-plan-generator): Builds week-long instructional plans with pacing and activity structure.
- [AI Worksheets Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/worksheet-generator): Produces printable or assignable worksheets for classroom practice and review.

## Standards and Resource Discovery
- [Browse by Standard](https://wayground.com/admin/resource-library/standard/mathematics): Entry point for discovering standards-aligned instructional resources in mathematics.
- [Mathematics Standards Resources](https://wayground.com/admin/resource-library/standard/mathematics): Standards-based math resource library for lesson and activity discovery.

## Video Library
- [Math Video Library](https://wayground.com/video-library/math): Central library of math videos organized by grade and topic.
- [Kindergarten Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/kindergarten-math): Math video collection for kindergarten concepts and foundational skills.
- [1st Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/1st-grade-math): Math videos covering first-grade topics and practice areas.
- [2nd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/2nd-grade-math): Grade 2 math video library for core skills and standards.
- [3rd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/3rd-grade-math): Grade 3 math videos for instruction, review, and reinforcement.
- [4th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/4th-grade-math): Grade 4 math video resources organized for classroom use.
- [5th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/5th-grade-math): Grade 5 math videos supporting standards-aligned learning and review.
- [6th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/6th-grade-math): Grade 6 math video library for middle school concepts.
- [7th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/7th-grade-math): Grade 7 math videos for practice, instruction, and intervention.

## Teacher Planning Tools
- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/lesson-plan-generator): Planning tool for creating daily lessons with objectives and activities.
- [Unit Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/unit-plan-generator): Long-range planning tool for sequencing lessons across a unit.
- [Weekly Lesson Plan Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/weekly-plan-generator): Weekly planning workflow for organizing instruction across multiple days.
- [AI Presentation Maker](https://wayground.com/generators/ai-presentation-maker): Presentation creation tool for direct instruction and classroom delivery.
- [AI Worksheets Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/worksheet-generator): Worksheet creation tool for independent practice, homework, and review.

## Assessment and Evaluation
- [AI Question Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/multiple-choice-question-generator): Assessment authoring tool for generating quiz and test questions.
- [AI Rubric Generator](https://wayground.com/generators/rubric-generator): Evaluation tool for defining performance criteria and scoring levels.
- [AI Math Problem Generator](http://wayground.com/generators/math-problem-generator): Practice and assessment generator for math fluency and problem solving.
- [Browse by Standard](https://wayground.com/admin/resource-library/standard/mathematics): Standards-based discovery for assessment-aligned instructional materials.

## District and School Solutions
- [School & District](https://wayground.com/home/schools-and-districts): District solution page for curriculum support, implementation, and progress visibility.
- [Plans](https://wayground.com/home/plans): Plan options relevant to individual teachers and institutional adoption.
- [Wayground Homepage](https://wayground.com): Overview of platform capabilities for classroom and system-wide use.

## Math Learning Resources
- [Math Video Library](https://wayground.com/video-library/math): Broad collection of math instructional videos across elementary and middle grades.
- [Kindergarten Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/kindergarten-math): Early math video resources for counting, shapes, and number sense.
- [1st Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/1st-grade-math): Grade 1 videos for foundational arithmetic and problem solving.
- [2nd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/2nd-grade-math): Grade 2 resources for operations, place value, and measurement.
- [3rd Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/3rd-grade-math): Grade 3 videos for multiplication, division, and fractions.
- [4th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/4th-grade-math): Grade 4 resources for multi-digit operations and geometry.
- [5th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/5th-grade-math): Grade 5 videos for fractions, decimals, and volume.
- [6th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/6th-grade-math): Grade 6 resources for ratios, expressions, and introductory statistics.
- [7th Grade Math](https://wayground.com/video-library/math/7th-grade-math): Grade 7 videos for proportional reasoning, equations, and geometry.
